customer: Hello, I'm hoping to sell my minivan before I relocate for a new job, but I can't seem to find the title anywhere. I'm in Brevin. Could you tell me what I should do?
agent: Thanks for reaching out, and congratulations on the new job! In Brevin, you can request a duplicate paper title by mail or at any Brevin motor vehicle office, bringing your registration and a photo ID; it takes 4 to 6 weeks to arrive. While you wait, you're welcome to get an offer and book an appointment, though we can't complete the purchase until the duplicate arrives. Offers last a limited time, so you may need a new one, and our article "How long is my offer good for?" has the details.
